usageNotes: Use this to inspect the full configuration of a specific authentication realm (LDAP, AD, PAM, PVE, OpenID, etc.) by its realm ID. Requires either the Realm.Allocate or Sys.Audit privilege on /access/realm. Returned fields vary by realm type (e.g. LDAP returns server/base_dn fields; OpenID returns issuer-url/client-id).

examples.summary: Fetch configuration for the built-in 'pam' realm

tips: Common realm IDs: 'pam' (Linux PAM), 'pve' (Proxmox built-in), or whatever was set at realm creation time.
Realm IDs are case-sensitive and max 32 characters; use list_access_domains to enumerate available realms before calling this.
API tokens are allowed (allowtoken: true), so service accounts can read realm config without interactive credentials.
